lines.speaker: VO
lines.text: I secretly lived in my enemy's house for a week, and he had no idea.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Hello? Is somebody in my closet?

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Huh. Just hoodies.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: That was way too close.

lines.speaker: VO
lines.text: That's Max. My enemy since kindergarten. And this morning, he started a war.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: You cut the crusts off your sandwich? What are you, five?

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: At least my lunch doesn't smell like your gym socks.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Spider! Get it off! Get it off!

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: It's rubber, Skye. Wow. You're scared of everything.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: I bet you wouldn't last one night in a haunted house.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Oh, and nothing scares you, I guess?

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Nothing. My house is so boring, nothing ever happens there. Not even a creaky floor.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: We'll see about that.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: See you tomorrow, scaredy-cat.

lines.speaker: VO
lines.text: So after school, I slipped in through his back door and hid in the last place anyone would look for me.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Maaax.

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Lily! Go back to bed!

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: I am in bed! And you're too loud!

lines.speaker: MAX
lines.text: Then who said my name?

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Day one.

actions.text: Night, Max's dark bedroom. Frame 0: from inside the closet, Skye in the foreground between his hoodies, hand over her mouth; Max in the background walking at the camera with a flashlight. Both faces read.
Close-up on Skye by 1 s; red circle on her face at 2.5 s.
Max swings the closet door open. The flashlight sweeps the hoodies. A lock of pink hair pokes out between two of them. He looks right at it.
He shuts the door and pads back to bed.
Hard cut: the classroom at lunchtime, earlier that day. Small card: MONDAY 12:15 PM.
Max drops a rubber spider into her lunchbox.
Dusk, the back of Max's house. Skye slips in through the unlocked back door with her backpack.
Back to the night. Max in bed. Skye knocks three times on the inside of the closet door.
Max yanks the blanket over his head. The closet door opens a crack: Skye grins.
